messages:
harper_rel: Heads-up: small rollout tonight 00:30 UTC for SDK 3.7. Change: runtime binding fallback order tightened; older runtimes may drop model variants. Planning a staggered pin plan if canaries show regressions.

diego_platform: Suggestion: use short TTL tenant pins first rather than global. Command: `rbctl runtime pin --tenant T-77 --runtime-version v2.15 --ttl 24h --reason \"sdk3.7 compat hold\"`. Keeps blast radius small.

mira_qa: Running canaries now. Preliminary: EU/NA canaries look stable, APAC showing 1.8% quality drift on rerank tests with runtime v2.14.

ben_sre: Propose triggers for pin: quality drift >1.5% sustained 10m OR error rate +3% sustained 5m OR p95 latency +200ms sustained 10m. Manual pin only.

clare_prod: We'll notify affected accounts and add a short note in release notes about tenant pin options and migration steps.

deploybot: [deploybot] canaries scheduled: NA 00:30 UTC, EU 00:45 UTC, APAC 01:00 UTC. Telemetry hooks enabled.

harper_rel: If APAC breaches triggers, manual owner for tenant pin is @diego_platform. If Diego is unreachable, @ben_sre will run the pin.

mira_qa: Final canary: APAC drift peaked 1.9% for 12m, recommendation: tenant-pin affected customers and hold global unpin.

diego_platform: Executing tenant pins for T-77 and T-19 now: `rbctl runtime pin --tenant T-77 --runtime-version v2.15 --ttl 24h --reason "sdk3.7 compat hold"` — done. `rbctl runtime pin --tenant T-19 ...` — done.

clare_prod: Account managers contacted for both tenants. Release notes updated with migration snippet and opt-out link.

harper_rel: OK we'll keep pins for 24h and reassess after extended telemetry. Closing thread; will reopen if further rollbacks needed.
